stories.headline: Russia fires ~70 missiles and 130 drones at Ukraine on Putin's birthday; at least 24 killed

key_facts.fact: Russia struck Kyiv and 12 Ukrainian regions overnight into Oct 7, which coincided with Vladimir Putin's 74th birthday; Zelensky said 70 missiles, many ballistic, were fired along with Shahed drones.
key_facts.excerpt: the October 7 attack included "70 missiles in total, many of them ballistic, as well as Shahed-drones" launched on 12 Ukrainian regions.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 130 drones, 48 cruise missiles and an unspecified number of ballistic missiles; air defences downed 161 targets.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia launched 130 drones, 48 cruise missiles, and an unspecified number of ballistic missiles in the overnight attack. It added air defence units downed 161 targets.

key_facts.fact: A Russian missile destroyed a five-storey apartment building in Pryluky, Chernihiv region; AP reported at least 24 civilians killed nationwide, including four children.
key_facts.excerpt: Russian strikes on Ukrainian cities kill at least 24 in a major attack that Kyiv saw coming

key_facts.fact: Kyiv Independent later tallied at least 28 killed and 134 injured over 24 hours, 18 of them in Pryluky.
key_facts.excerpt: At least 28 people were killed and at least 134 were injured in Russian attacks against Ukraine in the past 24 hours... Eighteen of those killed died when a Russian cruise missile hit a residential building in Pryluky

key_facts.fact: Russia's Defence Ministry said it targeted sites where Fire Point makes and stores Flamingo cruise missiles and long-range drones, plus port and ship-repair infrastructure in Odesa.
key_facts.excerpt: Targets included sites where the company Fire Point makes and stores Flamingo cruise missiles and medium- and long-range drones in Kyiv

key_facts.fact: Ukraine said it hit two oil facilities and a training ground in Russia's Perm, Samara and Astrakhan regions; Russia said naval drones set a Liberian-flagged tanker ablaze near Sochi, with all 23 Indian crew rescued.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia's Transport Ministry said a Liberian-flagged tanker had been attacked by "naval drones" near ... Sochi ... the crew of 23, all Indian citizens, had been rescued

key_facts.fact: Ukraine lacks ammunition for its US-made Patriot systems to stop Russian ballistic missiles; Patriot interceptors are in short supply due to the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine is looking worldwide for available Patriot missiles, which are in short supply due to the Iran war.

stories.headline: Vance signals softer US enrichment demand on Iran as Rubio says Tehran lost control of Hormuz

key_facts.fact: In a Reuters interview published Tuesday, VP JD Vance said Iran must make a 'meaningful' cut to its enrichment capacity to end the war, rather than Trump's earlier 'no enrichment' demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Vice President JD Vance appeared to soften U.S. demands on Iran to end the war Tuesday, saying Tehran must do something "meaningful" to reduce their nuclear enrichment

key_facts.fact: Speaking in Athens on Oct 7, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Iran had 'lost complete control' of the Strait of Hormuz and its economy was 'in total and complete freefall'.
key_facts.excerpt: "The Straits of Hormuz are open. There's almost as much oil flowing out now as there was before this conflict began. So they've lost complete control of the Straits," Rubio told reporters during a visit to Athens.

key_facts.fact: IRGC adviser Mohammad Reza Naqdi said 'illegal' routes along Oman's coast would soon be blocked and that the strait remains closed until Iran's demands are met.
key_facts.excerpt: Transit routes in the Strait of Hormuz deemed illegal by Iran will soon be closed, an adviser to the Revolutionary Guards' Commander told the semi-official Fars News Agency on Wednesday

key_facts.fact: Iran's army spokesman said Wednesday the armed forces were prepared to carry out pre-emptive strikes in the war against the US.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's army spokesman said on Wednesday that the armed forces were prepared to carry out pre-emptive strikes in the war against the US

key_facts.fact: On Tuesday 12 crew were injured when a projectile struck the Panama-flagged tanker On Peace in the strait; Oman rescued 10 crew after the vessel caught fire.
key_facts.excerpt: On Tuesday, Oman's defense ministry said in a statement that it rescued 10 crew members from the commercial vessel On Peace, which caught fire after being attacked.

key_facts.fact: The cost of shipping oil from the Persian Gulf to China hit a record $1.3 million a day on Monday, versus close to $60,000 a day on average last year.
key_facts.excerpt: The cost of carrying oil from inside the Persian Gulf to China rose to a record $1.3 million a day Monday, according to data from the Baltic Exchange in London. The rate averaged close to $60,000 a day last year

key_facts.fact: Gulf oil flows excluding Iran reached more than 81% of pre-war levels in September, according to Kpler.
key_facts.excerpt: Gulf oil flows, excluding Iran, reached more than 81 percent of pre-war levels in September, according to maritime intelligence firm Kpler.

stories.headline: S&P 500 closes above 7,800 for first time as 10-year yield eases from 2002 high

key_facts.fact: On Oct 6 the S&P 500 rose 0.58% to a record 7,818.93, its first close above 7,800; the Nasdaq added 0.45% to a record 27,599.79 and the Dow 0.49% to 51,521.28.
key_facts.excerpt: The S&P 500 rose 0.58% to a record 7,818.93 and the Nasdaq Composite gained 0.45% to a record 27,599.79. The Dow added 0.49% to 51,521.28

key_facts.fact: The 10-year Treasury yield fell about 4 basis points to 5.27% after Monday's 5.31% close, the highest since April 2002.
key_facts.excerpt: The 10-year yield fell 0.040 percentage point to 5.270% ... after a two-session climb that had taken it to 5.310% on Monday, the highest close since April 2002.

key_facts.fact: Treasury sold $58 billion of three-year notes at 4.932%, the highest three-year auction yield since May 2006.
key_facts.excerpt: The Treasury sold $58 billion of three-year notes at 1 p.m. at a high yield of 4.932%

key_facts.fact: Futures priced roughly a 20% chance of a Fed rate increase at the Oct 27-28 meeting and about 86% by December; minutes of the September meeting, at which the Fed raised rates, were due Wednesday.
key_facts.excerpt: Futures priced roughly a 20% chance of a rate increase at the Fed's Oct. 27 and 28 meeting, and about 86% by December.

key_facts.fact: Brent settled around $101 a barrel and WTI near $89.80; gold futures rose 1% to $4,195 an ounce and bitcoin traded around $85,500.
key_facts.excerpt: West Texas Intermediate crude futures were up 0.4% to $89.80 a barrel ... Brent crude futures ... 0.7% higher at $101 ... Gold futures rose 1% to $4,195 an ounce.

key_facts.fact: The rally was narrow: the Russell 2000 fell 0.59% and the XBI biotech ETF fell 3.39% as healthcare was the only S&P sector to decline.
key_facts.excerpt: The Russell 2000 fell 0.59% as health care sold off: XBI.US closed 3.39% lower.

stories.headline: US government, Google DeepMind and Meta join Biohub's $1.8B push to build AI-ready biology data

key_facts.fact: Biohub announced on Oct 7 that the US government, Alphabet and Meta are joining its Virtual Biology Initiative, bringing commitments to $1.8 billion in funding, data, compute and measurement technology.
key_facts.excerpt: Biohub announced on Wednesday that the U.S. government, Google $GOOGL parent Alphabet, and Meta $META are joining its Virtual Biology Initiative, bringing total commitments to $1.8 billion

key_facts.fact: Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs and Meta are collectively investing $300 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Google DeepMind, Meta, and AI drug discovery startup Isomorphic Labs are jointly investing $300 million into Biohub

key_facts.fact: The Department of Energy will invest more than $500 million over five years through its Genesis Mission; NIH brings datasets built with more than $500 million in prior federal funding.
key_facts.excerpt: the Department of Energy is directing more than $500 million across five years ... NIH will help organize datasets and repositories that were assembled using more than $500 million in prior federal funding

key_facts.fact: NIH said it will coordinate through its 'Bio Genesis Mission' to build 'SI-ready' (superintelligence-ready) data for predictive models of how cells respond to disease and interventions.
key_facts.excerpt: NIH is coordinating with the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), Biohub and other partners to develop the data and resources needed to develop Super Intelligence (SI) models

key_facts.fact: The goal is a 'virtual cell' model; Biohub had committed $500 million to the effort in April. Biohub head of science Alex Rives called it 'one of the most important challenges for the next era of science'.
key_facts.excerpt: the creation of a virtual cell is one of the most important challenges for the next era of science

stories.headline: Brussels weighs broad levy on all large companies to tax US Big Tech without a digital tax

key_facts.fact: The European Commission is considering taxing US tech groups such as Apple, Meta and Google through a broad levy on large corporations, to avoid a backlash from the Trump administration, the FT reported on Oct 7 citing six officials.
key_facts.excerpt: Brussels is considering taxing big US tech companies through a broad levy on large corporations in an effort to raise revenues for the EU while avoiding a backlash from the Trump administration

key_facts.fact: The plan would modify the 'Corporate Resource for Europe' (CORE) proposal, which charges every company with more than EUR100 million in EU revenue a fixed annual levy of EUR100,000 to EUR750,000.
key_facts.excerpt: In its current form, CORE requires these companies to pay a fixed annual levy of between €100,000 and €750,000

key_facts.fact: Trump threatened in June a 100% tariff on all goods from any country imposing a digital services tax on US companies.
key_facts.excerpt: US President Donald Trump in June threatened a 100% tariff on all goods from any country that imposes a digital services tax on American companies.

key_facts.fact: CORE is one of five new 'own resources' meant to raise about EUR60bn a year from 2028; a majority of EU states currently oppose CORE and any change needs unanimity of all 27.
key_facts.excerpt: Core is one of five new "own resources" meant to raise about €60bn a year from 2028 ... a majority of EU countries currently oppose Core ... any change needs unanimity of all 27.

key_facts.fact: France, Italy, Spain and Austria, which have national digital levies, face US Section 301 investigations that could lead to tariffs.
key_facts.excerpt: France, Italy, Spain and Austria, which have national digital levies, face US Section 301 investigations that could lead to tariffs.

stories.headline: South Korea's Nuri rocket deploys five NEONSAT satellites, its fourth straight success

key_facts.fact: Nuri lifted off from the Naro Space Center at 12:25 p.m. local time on Oct 7 (0325 GMT) carrying 15 satellites, South Korea's first orbital launch of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Liftoff occurred at 11:25 p.m. EDT (0325 GMT and 12:25 p.m. local time on Oct. 7).

key_facts.fact: All five NEONSAT microsatellites (Nos. 2-6), the primary payload for the country's first domestically launched microsatellite constellation, deployed; nine of 10 CubeSats separated, while Quaternion's PERSAT-02 failed to separate.
key_facts.excerpt: The rocket successfully deployed its primary payload of five ... NEONSAT microsatellites, while nine of its 10 CubeSat secondary payloads were released as planned

key_facts.fact: It was Nuri's fifth launch and fourth consecutive success, raising its success rate from 75% to 80%; it was also the first Nuri launch to proceed without delay.
key_facts.excerpt: The mission was Nuri's fifth launch overall and its fourth consecutive success after its maiden flight failed in 2021, raising its overall launch success rate from 75 percent to 80 percent.

key_facts.fact: Each NEONSAT weighs under 100 kg and can resolve objects as small as 1 meter; the full 10-satellite constellation, completed by a sixth Nuri flight in H2 2027, will image the Korean Peninsula more than three times a day.
key_facts.excerpt: Each NEONSAT weighs less than 100 kilograms and carries an electro-optical camera capable of distinguishing objects as small as 1 meter

key_facts.fact: All five NEONSATs made initial ground contact by 5:52 p.m.; the government has added five more Nuri flights through 2032 with 328 billion won ($245.1 million) in extra funding.
key_facts.excerpt: the government has since added five more flights through 2032, backed by an additional 328 billion won ($245.1 million) in funding.

stories.headline: ViiV's long-acting HIV shot Cabenuva beats daily pills in patients with uncontrolled virus

key_facts.fact: ViiV Healthcare, majority owned by GSK, said on Oct 6 that the phase IIIb CROWN study met its primary endpoint: at six months long-acting Cabenuva achieved superior viral suppression versus standard daily oral therapy.
key_facts.excerpt: London, 6 October – ViiV Healthcare ... today announced the phase IIIb CROWN study met its primary endpoint, demonstrating that at six months, long-acting Cabenuva ... achieved superior rates of viral suppression

key_facts.fact: The trial enrolled people with HIV-1 who still had detectable virus despite prior daily oral treatment; the injection is given six times a year.
key_facts.excerpt: people living with HIV-1 who have detectable virus despite a history of daily oral ART can directly initiate CAB + RPV LA, administered six times a year

key_facts.fact: CROWN enrolled about 326 adults and adolescents across eight countries at 85 sites.
key_facts.excerpt: The study enrolled approximately 326 participants, including adults and adolescents, across eight countries at 85 study sites.

key_facts.fact: Use in people with detectable virus is not yet approved; data will be shared with health authorities for regulatory review, with full results at an upcoming scientific meeting.
key_facts.excerpt: Use of CAB + RPV LA in people with detectable viremia is investigational and has not been approved by regulatory authorities. ... Full results are planned for presentation at an upcoming scientific meeting.
